recommended_direction.name: TWO-PHASE_EVIDENCE_SEAL_AND_RECONCILE
phase_1_build_seal: Finalize all Builder evidence bytes before packet construction.
Fresh-read final Builder evidence and bind raw SHA256 plus Git blob SHA in the B-to-C packet.
Bind exact branch commit/tree and packet artifact SHA/blob set; prohibit post-seal mutation of the evidence object used for verification.
phase_2_c_reconcile: C fresh-reads packet and final evidence independently, recomputes raw SHA256 and blob SHA, and rejects any mismatch before accepting execution claims.
C verifies packet/evidence branch commit-tree binding and exact artifact set before test-result promotion.
C treats Builder test counts only as claims until an exact-byte executable/trusted-CI run is independently tied to the same sealed evidence snapshot.
post_c_owner_run: Even after Step008 C PASS, keep E3 blocked until real owner Windows installation/canary evidence exists and Online reconciliation binds installation_id, authorization, bundle hash, command/canary identity, provenance, and replay/dedupe state.
Do not put standby-model output in the authority or attestation path.

adversarial_checks_for_c_or_future_forma: POST_SEAL_EVIDENCE_MUTATION: mutate evidence after packet SHA capture; verifier must reject.
PACKET_REPLAY_AGAINST_NEW_BRANCH_HEAD: old sealed packet/evidence against changed commit/tree must reject or require explicit pinned historical verification.
BLOB_RAW_SHA_SPLIT: raw SHA matches expected semantic content but blob SHA differs because bytes/newlines differ; fail closed.
ARTIFACT_SET_SPLICE: one artifact from a different commit with same filename; fail closed.
OWNER_BUNDLE_REPLAY: valid prior installation evidence replayed under new authorization/session/cursor; no E3 promotion.
ATTESTOR_SELF_REFERENCE: evidence generator or validator outside the bound trust-anchor set; quarantine until independently pinned.
veto_assessment: NO_NEW_VETO_REQUIRED; current formal C gate already owns the affected verification scope. Raise a bounded veto only if a future proposal allows post-seal evidence mutation, unbound replay, model-authored attestation authority, or E3 promotion before real-local reconciliation.
